question: What confirmation should the brahmin give regarding the completion of the rite?
premises: The brahmin is the one who speaks.
The rite is assessed for proper completion.
The declaration states it is complete with all parts according to rule.
inference: The brahmin should declare that it has been properly accomplished with all its parts according to rule.
plain_english: The brahmin should declare that it has been properly accomplished, complete with all its parts, according to rule.
